وَخَصَّهُ: And He specifically singled him out
الْمَحْفُوفِ: The one who is surrounded by a retinue or attendants.
وَسَلَّمَ: And he sent greetings of peace (salutations).
الْمُسْنِدُ: The narrator of continuous chain of transmission
النَّضْرِ: The gharība (strange), or the nadr (rare) hadith
أَوْرَدْنَاهُ: We have caused them to drink
وَأَكْرَهُ: And he made him detest it
وَسَرَرُهُ: And He made them a source of joy
مَوْضُوعَةً،: fixed or placed in a certain position,
فَكَلَّفُوا: Then they took it upon themselves
وَسَوَادِي،: And as for those who are blackened,
أُعَفِّرُ: I will cover it with dust or ashes.
